dublinCore.dc:title: 119 HR 10228 IH: Strengthening Protections for Children with Food Allergies Act
dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. DeSaulnier (for himself and Ms. Matsui) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce

form.official-title: To amend the Child Nutrition Act of 1966 to require the provision of training and information to certain personnel relating to food allergy identification and response, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Strengthening Protections for Children with Food Allergies Act.
Section 7(g)(2)(B) of the Child Nutrition Act of 1966 (42 U.S.C. 1776(g)(2)(B)) is amended—

paragraph.text: in clause (iii), by amending subclause (II) to read as follows:

subclause.text: food allergies, including information on best practices—

item.text: to prevent, recognize, and respond to food-related allergic reactions, including through the administration of epinephrine in FDA-approved delivery systems in the case of a severe allergic reaction such as anaphylaxis;
for communicating food allergen information in school menus, food products, and recipes;
regarding appropriate food substitutions for children with food allergies;

paragraph.text: by adding at the end the following:

clause.text: The training required under this subparagraph shall be provided, as the Secretary determines to be necessary, in—

subclause.text: relevant languages other than English, for individuals with limited English proficiency; and
relevant alternative formats, for individuals with disabilities (as defined in section 3 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. 12102)).

clause.text: The Secretary shall make the training provided under this subparagraph available to personnel under child nutrition programs not covered under this subsection, including personnel under—

subclause.text: the special milk program under section 3;
the summer food service program for children under section 13 of the Richard B. Russell National School Lunch Act (42 U.S.C. 1761); and
the child and adult care food program under section 17 of that Act (42 U.S.C. 1766).

clause.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this subparagraph $1,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031.

section.header: Activities to support WIC-eligible individuals impacted by food allergies
section.text: Section 17 of the Child Nutrition Act of 1966 (42 U.S.C. 1786) is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating subsections (l) through (s) as subsections (m) through (t), respectively;
by inserting after subsection (k) the following:

subsection.header: Activities To support WIC–Eligible individuals impacted by food allergies

paragraph.text: In accordance with subsection (e), the Secretary shall—

subparagraph.text: submit to the Secretary of Health and Human Services for comment proposed nutrition education materials for use under subsection (e), which shall—

clause.text: incorporate evidence-based findings from the United States Dietary Guidelines for Americans relating to food allergies and potentially allergenic foods; and

subclause.text: individuals with food allergies during pregnancy and in the postpartum period;
infants impacted by prenatal food allergy exposure; and

subparagraph.text: after submitting the materials in accordance with subparagraph (A), publish and disseminate the materials for use under subsection (e).
The nutrition education materials under paragraph (1) shall be provided, as the Secretary determines to be necessary, in—

clause.text: relevant languages other than English for individuals with limited English proficiency; and
relevant alternative formats for individuals with disabilities (as defined in section 3 of the Americans With Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. 12102)).

subparagraph.text: In carrying out this paragraph, the Secretary shall conduct outreach to individuals who are, or may be—

subclause.text: the program under this section; or
a training program of a State agency under subsection (e)(2); and

paragraph.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this subsection $1,000,000 for fiscal year 2027.

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (1), by striking subsection (o)(1)(A) and inserting subsection (p)(1)(A); and
in paragraph (2)(B), by striking subsection (o)(1)(A) and inserting subsection (p)(1)(A); and

paragraph.text: in paragraph (5) of subsection (t) (as redesignated by paragraph (1)), by striking subsection (r) and inserting subsection (s).
